skill_name: Suggest two ways for a small business to be more eco-friendly and reduce their environmental impact.
workflow: One way for a small business to be more eco-friendly and reduce their environmental impact is to reduce waste. This can be achieved by implementing a recycling program, using reusable containers, encouraging the use of digital documents, reducing single use items and encouraging employees to use more energy efficient methods.
